arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,random
random.seed(88)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)]
services=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
limits={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
events=[]
for st in range(16):
 S=set()
 while len(S)<800:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(5)))
 text='(startswith(A,B) and contains(C,D)) allow;(endswith(D,A) or match(E)) allow;(contains(C,D) and startswith(A,B)) drop;(startswith(A,B) and (contains(C,D) or endswith(D,A))) allow;(endswith(D,A) and contains(C,D)) allow;'
 text+=''.join('match('+','.join(names[i] for i in t)+') allow;' for t in S)
 events.append({'op':'stage','epoch':0xFFFFFFFF-st,'policy':text})
 events.append({'op':'commit','epoch':0xFFFFFFFF-st})
while len(events)<200000:events.append({'op':'inspect'})
req={'jobs':[{'services':services,'limits':limits,'events':events}]}
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('input',len(data),'policybytes',sum(len(e['policy'].encode()) for e in events if e['op']=='stage'))
open('/workspace/tmp/big_output.json','wb').write(data)
PY
cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='ELAPSED %R user %U sys %S'; time python3 launch.py < /workspace/tmp/big_output.json > /workspace/tmp/big_output.out; echo status:$?; ls -lh /workspace/tmp/big_output.out; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/big_output.out'))
ev=r['results'][0]['events']
print(len(ev), ev[0].get('error'), ev[-1])
PY
